calls.name: read_file
calls.expectToolResult: a half rounds up, as `Math.round` does

explanation.what: docs/design.md says a half cent rounds up, and the export now rounds it to the even cent.
explanation.why: AGENTS.md says "If you change a behaviour that docs/design.md describes, change the document in the same commit.", and this change altered the rounding without touching the document.
explanation.fix: Change the rounding sentence in docs/design.md to say a half cent rounds to the even cent, to match the bank's statements.

arguments.failureScenario: dollars(0.5) now returns "0.00" and dollars(2.5) returns "0.02", while docs/design.md still says a half rounds up, as Math.round does, which gives "0.01" and "0.03". AGENTS.md says "If you change a behaviour that docs/design.md describes, change the document in the same commit.", so a reader who trusts the design reconciles exports against the wrong rule.
